checks.title: Confirm launch and pipeline owners
checks.instructions: Name the GTM, launch, Sales, contact, and budget owners; target buyer, market, useful outcome, launch window, and escalation path.

checks.title: Review offer and claims
checks.instructions: Record offer version, approved product claims, customer evidence and source dates. Separate observed problems from message hypotheses; verify the owner approves public claims before distribution.

checks.title: Bind assets, channels, and budget
checks.instructions: Record site and asset revisions, campaign and source IDs, channels, publish/send owners, budget caps, dependencies, and exact approval routes. An approved asset is not a provider-confirmed publication.

checks.title: Define qualified pipeline evidence
checks.instructions: Record useful visitor action, qualified lead criteria, duplicate and contact policy, CRM stage and meeting definitions, attribution limits, source coverage, baseline or baseline-first choice, and observation window.

checks.title: Bind GTM and Sales Crews
checks.instructions: Inspect existing compatible Crews before proposing new ones. Record ready GTM Strategy Analyst, Launch Coordinator, Lead Intake & Qualifier, and Sales Follow-up Coordinator IDs and selected skills. Add Website Growth or distribution capabilities only where useful.

checks.title: Probe actual sources and permissions
checks.instructions: Read one authorized offer source, campaign or publication state, inbound event, CRM lead, prior-contact/suppression state, and meeting source or mark gaps blocked. A named provider is not connected access.

checks.title: Validate all selected handoffs
checks.instructions: Run this package's GTM validator on the reviewed strategy brief, launch signal register, and linked lead; reject mismatched offer, campaign, source, duplicate or consent state. Install and run the Sales Playbook validator before Follow-up reads qualification; invalid fixtures must stop consumers.

checks.title: Review the concrete Automation
checks.instructions: Show Crew IDs, source and output paths, validator steps, claimed and unknown attribution, exact publish/contact approval points, budget, notification and repeat policy, and provider receipts before Builder applies it.

checks.title: Run one authorized route manually
checks.instructions: Use one real or historical launch and inbound lead. Save run IDs, actual validator results, owner decisions and source state. A fictional fixture, draft, form event, or CRM stage without verification does not prove a qualified lead or meeting.

checks.title: Choose recurrence and action ledger
checks.instructions: Record stable launch, asset, campaign, event, lead and action IDs; deduplicate before retries. Choose manual-only or a reviewed authenticated event/schedule with concurrency, cost, delivery and contact policy. Setup completion alone enables no distribution or outreach.
